gold: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising in a seborrheic keratosis of the eyelid

selector.rationale: The histopathological examination reveals a classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts and proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells, which are characteristic features of squamous cell carcinoma.

support_spans: Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
